mapper.sql: t1.fnd20_plan_id AS plan_id, t1.fnd20_fund_id AS fund_id, t1.fnd20_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, f_class_tree_nm_allpath(t3.dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name, f_cdnm('ApprovalTypeCode', t3.dcr01_approval_type_cd, t3.dcr01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS approval_type_name, t1.fnd20_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(t1.fnd20_person_id) AS person_name, f_org_nm((SELECT emp03_org_code_id FROM emp03_trans WHERE (emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date) IN ( SELECT emp03_person_id, max(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = t1.fnd20_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= t1.fnd20_start_date GROUP BY emp03_person_id)) , t1.fnd20_start_date) AS org_name, t1.fnd20_start_date AS start_date, t1.fnd20_due_date AS due_date, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t1.fnd20_appr_id, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', t4.apr01_status_cd, t2.fnd01_company_id, t1.fnd20_start_date) END AS close_yn, t1.fnd20_note AS note, t1.fnd20_manager_id AS manager_id, t1.fnd20_appr_id AS appr_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fnd20_plan t1 INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code t2 ON t1.fnd20_fund_id = t2.fnd01_fund_code_id INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree t3 ON t1.fnd20_class_tree_id = t3.dcr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr t4 ON t1.fnd20_appr_id = t4.apr01_appr_id WHERE t1.fnd20_fund_id = #{fundId} AND t2.fnd01_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY t3.dcr01_seq

SELECT FROM fnd20_plan t1 INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code t2 ON t1.fnd20_fund_id = t2.fnd01_fund_code_id INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree t3 ON t1.fnd20_class_tree_id = t3.dcr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr t4 ON t1.fnd20_appr_id = t4.apr01_appr_id WHERE t1.fnd20_plan_id = #{planId} AND t2.fnd01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fnd20_plan (fnd20_plan_id, fnd20_fund_id, fnd20_class_tree_id, fnd20_start_date, fnd20_due_date, fnd20_person_id, fnd20_manager_id, fnd20_note) VALUES (#{planId}, #{req.fundId}, #{req.classTreeId}, #{req.startDate}, #{req.dueDate}, #{req.personId}, #{managerId}, #{req.note})
mapper.update: UPDATE fnd20_plan SET fnd20_class_tree_id = #{req.classTreeId}, fnd20_start_date = #{req.startDate}, fnd20_due_date = #{req.dueDate}, fnd20_person_id = #{req.personId}, fnd20_note = #{req.note} WHERE fnd20_plan_id = #{req.planId}
